description: React component implementing an interactive D3 force-directed graph for a career pathway roadmap visualization, including data fetching, graph rendering, node interaction, and saving functionality.

methods.name: normalizeProgress
methods.description: Normalizes progress status strings to standardized values ('completed', 'in_progress', 'not_started').

methods.name: nodeProgress
methods.description: Retrieves and normalizes the progress status for a given node based on stored progress data.

methods.name: isSkill
methods.description: Checks if a node is of type 'skill'.

methods.name: effectiveNodeIsGap
methods.description: Determines if a node is considered a gap based on its properties and progress.

methods.name: nodeFillColor
methods.description: Returns the fill color for a node based on its type and progress status.

methods.name: effectiveLinkIsGap
methods.description: Determines if a link is considered a gap based on its properties and connected nodes.

methods.name: Graph
methods.description: Main React component rendering an interactive graph with data fetching, graph rendering, node interaction, and save functionality.

methods.name: onNodeClick
methods.description: Handles node click events to load and display detailed information about the node.

methods.name: saveRoadmap
methods.description: Saves the current graph state as a roadmap via API call.

methods.name: onResetZoom
methods.description: Resets the zoom level of the graph to default.
